values.note: City of Adams: $25 a night, paid by honor-system envelope. A vehicle left to hold a site is charged a night.

fees.source: https://www.adamsmn.com/campground.html ('It costs $25 a night to camp', 'Payment is based on the honor system... Cost is $25.00 per night', 'If you are using a vehicle to hold your camping spot, you will be charged a night of camping'), read 2026-11-11

booking.source: https://www.adamsmn.com/campground.html ('The campground is a first come, first served campground'), read 2026-11-11

sites.source: https://www.adamsmn.com/campground.html ('There are 14 camping locations with water and electric hookup'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://www.adamsmn.com/campground.html ('14 camping locations with water and electric hookup'; amperage not stated), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.adamsmn.com/campground.html ('There is a sewer dumping station that is located by the City Park entrance'; 'a new showering and bathroom facility' built 2022), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Adams park campground; every site has water and electric. Honor-system self-pay: envelopes at the information board, dropped in the boxes there or at the bathroom/shower building (built 2022). The dump station is by the park entrance. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the city's page: $25 a night, first come first served (honor envelopes), 14 water+electric sites, dump station, showers (2022 building). Amperage, season close and site lengths not stated; the page says only 'The campground opened May 1st for the season!'. Pin sits in the park beside the campground loops; no water near.
flags: Missing phone: the city's government page gives the City Clerk's Office, (507) 582-3601 (adamsmn.com/government.html); the campground page itself lists no phone.
Season: the page says only 'The campground opened May 1st for the season!' (no closing date), so season was left unset.
